parent_objective: run artifact-only failure-slice diagnosis over the complete M2293 measured panel
blocked_by: M2294 classifies M2293 as offtrack/collision dominated and blocks direct repair/ranking
supersedes: direct reward repair from global success rate
direct profile ranking from M2293 aggregates

public_gates: M2295 must consume existing M2293 artifacts only
M2295 must not rerun environment reset or rollout
M2295 must produce slice diagnostics across role, timing, lateral, hidden dynamics, profile, outcome, and termination axes
M2295 must select a result-audit route without ranking profiles or claiming paper/self-ID evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: adds artifact-only failure slicing over the first complete 1080-episode role-family measured panel
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: failure-slice diagnosis only; no rollout ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2293 artifacts are missing or incomplete
stop if diagnosis cannot reproduce the M2293 global counts
stop if diagnosis attempts to rank profiles
stop if no dominant failure slice or next route can be identified
fallback_plan: route to artifact repair if input counts cannot be reproduced
route to branch synthesis if failure slices are contradictory
route to offtrack or collision-focused design only after result audit accepts the diagnosis
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2294 cadence synthesis continues to artifact-only failure-slice diagnosis

training_stage.stage_objective: implement and run artifact-only failure-slice diagnosis
admission_evidence: M2293 measured execution pass produced 1080 complete episode rows
M2294 blocks direct repair/ranking and routes to failure-slice diagnosis
allowed_updates: M2295 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2295 slices measured outcomes but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history, reset-hidden, or zero-history intervention is run in M2295.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Treat failure slices as task-performance diagnosis, not self-ID evidence.

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns a global offtrack-dominated result into slice-level failure evidence before repair
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can decide which current-sim task-quality repair route is evidence-backed
must_synthesize_if: M2295 cannot identify a dominant failure slice
M2295 recommends another broad repair without new slice evidence
M2295 repeats the same global finding without narrower route selection

hypothesis: Artifact-only failure-slice diagnosis can localize the M2293 offtrack/collision dominated result enough to choose the next non-ranking repair or synthesis route.
success_criteria: slice artifacts exist for role, timing, lateral, hidden dynamics, profile, outcome, and termination axes
no rollout, training, ranking, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim is made
failure_criteria: M2295 cannot reproduce M2293 global counts
M2295 ranks profiles or selects a winner
M2295 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
decision_rule: M2295 passes if it reproduces M2293 global counts, writes required slice diagnostics, and routes to result audit without rerun/ranking claims.
